candidate.definition_en: To stop something unwanted from spreading or increasing; also to originate from.
candidate.explanation_ar: ليها معنيين: يا إما يوقف تدفق أو انتشار حاجة (زي الدم أو أزمة)، يا إما ينبع أو ييجي من (زي المشاكل اللي بتيجي من سبب معين).

senses.definition_en: To stop something unwanted from spreading or increasing.
senses.definition_ar: يوقف أو يحد من انتشار شيء غير مرغوب فيه (مثل نزيف أو تدفق).
examples: They tried to stem the bleeding.
The government took measures to stem the tide of illegal immigration.

senses.definition_en: To originate or develop as the result of something (usually followed by 'from').
senses.definition_ar: ينبع من أو ينشأ عن شيء آخر.
examples: Most of his health problems stem from smoking.
They tried to stem the bleeding.
The government took measures to stem the tide of illegal immigration.
Most of his health problems stem from smoking.
candidate.mnemonic: زي ما الـ 'Stem' 'الساق' بيطلع من الأرض، المشاكل ممكن 'Stem from' 'تنبع من' أسباب معينة.
